## Anatomy

- `root`: Whatever the style is applied to: the frosted text panel on a project thumbnail, and the panel behind the side navigation. Thumbs, Carousel and Navigation use it.

## When to use

- The text panel on a project thumbnail, in Thumbs and Carousel, and Navigation's panel.

## When not to use

- A menu that opens over the page. That's the **Menu effect**.

## Behaviour

It blurs what's behind the panel. In Figma the blur is tied to `opacity/gentle`, an opacity token borrowed as a blur size. It works, but changing that opacity would also move this blur. Its own blur token would fix it.

## Accessibility

- **Contrast**: check the panel text against the busiest part of the thumbnail.

## Tokens

Every token this component uses, across all its variants.

| Token | Resolves to |
|---|---|
| `effect/thumb` | `blur(12px)` |
